# Adient Move 2026 makes a global impact


11/24/26


-
-
-
-


-
-
-


Adient Move, a global run/walk for Adient employees, families and communities to support wellness, teamwork and charitable giving, recently completed its sixth edition. The 2026 event brought more than 13,000 participants together across 19 countries and generated more than 53,000 kilograms of food for local communities.


“From the beginning, Move has united our global teams around well-being, community impact and a shared sense of purpose,” said Marcelo Assis, head of the South America region, who leads Move efforts globally. “Its continued growth reflects the strength of our people and culture.”


Each location tailored the event, giving participants opportunities to connect with colleagues, create lasting memories and support charitable causes. Remote participants also completed 5Ks in their communities, extending Move’s reach worldwide.


Move engaged more than 10,000 people across three countries in the Americas, resulting in 34,248 kilograms of food collected. In Asia, more than 2,000 people across five countries contributed 17,080 kilograms, while approximately 600 participants in 11 EMEA countries added 1,854 kilograms.


Thank you to the participants and organizers who made Move 2026 possible.
